_comment: Line-coverage gate for check-coverage.py. baseline = measured from the Domain.Tests/Application.Tests projects alone (Domain 68.6%, Application 74.3%, Windows, 2026-11-26); CI merges every project's report so it should read at or above these. A PR fails if an assembly is below its floor or more than ratchetTolerance points below its baseline. Ratchet: when the CI report shows improvement, record it as the new baseline and later raise the floor. Issue #134 targets 80% Domain / 70% Application.
